inventoryScope.includes: All assets currently represented by the typed media registry, verified Cloudinary assets, the canonical Level I capture plan, and planned real-tool captures for later levels.
inventoryScope.excludes: Unindexed historical R&D images from older chat/image-generation sessions whose binaries or stable identifiers are not currently available.
inventoryScope.rule: Do not claim this manifest is exhaustive until historical source binaries are reconciled. Add newly recovered exploration/reference/rejected assets here before publishing or deleting them.

migrationPolicy.legacyAssets: Leave dccmiami assets untouched until the new Moises.tech page is verified.
migrationPolicy.canonicalRule: Only uploaded assets with real returned metadata may be referenced by the public site.
migrationPolicy.generatedVsReal: Generated visual explanation is allowed; generated imagery may not impersonate real product UI, participant evidence, workshop evidence, or business results.
